examples.english: Weigh the vegetables on the scales.

examples.notes: [Note: {体重計|たいじゅうけい} is specifically a body weight scale]

notes:
{秤|はかり} is the general term for a weighing device — any type of scale or balance. Also sometimes written as はかり in hiragana or {計|はかり}.

TYPES OF SCALES:
- ⟦キッチン→キッチン：10815_kicchin⟧{秤|はかり}: kitchen scale
- ⟦デジタル→デジタル：05870_dejitaru⟧{秤|はかり}: digital scale
- ⟦{台秤|だいばかり}→台秤：noentry⟧: platform scale
- ⟦{天秤|てんびん}→天秤：05598_tenbin⟧: balance scale (also figurative: weighing options)
- ⟦{体重計|たいじゅうけい}→体重計：05485_taijuukei⟧: bathroom/body weight scale (uses {計|けい} not {秤|はかり})

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- ⟦{量|はか}る→量る：28293_hakaru⟧ / ⟦{計|はか}る→計る：28292_hakaru⟧: to measure, to weigh
- ⟦{重|おも}さ→重さ：14444_omosa⟧: weight
- ⟦{計量|けいりょう}→計量：14797_keiryou⟧: measurement

NOTE:
The kanji {秤|はかり} is not a common-use kanji (⟦{常用漢字|じょうようかんじ}→常用漢字：20778_jouyoukanji⟧), so it is often written in hiragana. In stores, ⟦{量|はか}り{売|う}り→量り売り：noentry⟧ means "sold by weight."
